Sara — great, thanks for the quick review. Short answers up front:

- Signatory order we propose: Calypso Legal -> Calypso Procurement -> Redwood Legal -> Redwood Finance -> Final signature by Calypso COO (per your org chart). We can flip the internal Redwood sequence if Procurement requires earlier finance sign-off, but this order minimizes rework on SOW redlines.
- Redwood internal approval window: we can commit to approvals completed within 48 business hours once we receive the final, signed SOW from your side. Practical last sign date to guarantee a 1 Apr pilot start is EOD Mar 19 (UTC).

I'm attaching a cleaned MAP and a proposed signature-matrix workbook showing signer windows across time zones. I'll also prep the SOW with incorporated redlines and send to legal for a quick pre-sign review.

Next steps for us: Laura will coordinate legal routing, Karthik will manage the SOW edge cases around data residency, Dev will confirm start-of-data-transfer timeline.

Regards,
Tessa Morgan
Senior AE, Redwood Inference

Subject: FW: Re: MAP draft and timing for pilots

Looping legal into the thread. Per Tessa, I27ll own routing the SOW and confirming who signs which pages. Two legal items I need clarified before routing to Calypso legal:

1) Data retention appendix — Karthik, is the requested 365-day retention mandatory for the pilot? If not, suggest 90 days for pilot.
2) SLA & uptime credits — Dev/Infra, confirm whether we27re comfortable with the proposed "99.5% monthly" for this scale pilot or want to add an explicit fallback plan.

If we get answers today, I can send a pre-reviewed SOW to ProcureOps legal by EOD Thu and request a 48-hour turnaround.

Thanks,
Laura Bennett
Director, Contracts & Commercial
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwoodinference.com>
To: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>, Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwoodinference.com>, Dev Patel <dev_patel@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Thu, 11 Mar 2027 11:40:00 -0700
Subject: Re: FW: Re: MAP draft and timing for pilots

Laura — for pilot we can accept 90-day retention. We'll document the 365-day option in the production SOW and call it out as an upgrade path. Regarding SLA: 99.5% is fine for pilot but we should add a defined escalation path and the automatic fallback to a lower-cost model variant if we detect sustained degradation. Dev, can you draft two bullets I can paste into the SOW?

Karthik
Staff Product, Redwood Inference
From: Dev Patel <dev_patel@redwoodinference.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwoodinference.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>, Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Fri, 12 Mar 2027 08:06:00 -0700
Subject: Re: FW: Re: MAP draft and timing for pilots

Karthik — two bullets for SOW:

- Escalation and mitigation: Redwood will notify Calypso within 10 minutes of incident detection; engineering-runbook and on-call will commence immediate triage and provide a preliminary impact summary within 90 minutes.
- Degradation fallback: If token-level latency exceeds 2.5x baseline for more than 30 minutes, traffic will be routed to a compatible, lower-cost model variant and cache-busting controls enabled; Redwood will log and monetize the impact per the fallback pricing schedule in Appendix B.

I'll attach a redlined SOW into the Drive folder and flag the specific clauses for Laura.

Dev Patel
Principal Infra Engineer, Redwood Inference

- Redwood can complete internal approvals within 48 business hours once we receive Calypso27s acceptance of the redlined SOW.
- Proposed signature sequence and windows (attached signature_matrix.xlsx):
  * Mar 15, 09:00-17:00 CET: Calypso Legal review and signature
  * Mar 16, 09:00-17:00 CET: Calypso Procurement countersign
  * Mar 17, 09:00-17:00 PST: Redwood Legal + Redwood Finance countersign
  * Mar 18, 09:00-17:00 PST: Final Calypso COO signature

If the above sequence executes on schedule we will be able to onboard production keys and begin data sync on Apr 1 as discussed. Please confirm acceptance of this sequence or send alternate windows by EOD Tue Mar 15. Once you confirm we27ll issue the DocuSign envelope and start the routing.
